title: A Blueprint for Equilibrium-Based Differentiable Continuous-Variable Thermodynamic Computing
abstract: arXiv:2607.16183v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To help address the escalating energy and latency demands of machine-learning workloads, we introduce a blueprint for an energy-efficient and fast thermodynamic computing stack that leverages stochastic analog processes in physical hardware. In this work, we focus on energy-based thermodynamic computing where the stochastic process is well described by Langevin dynamics with tunable energy potentials. The implementation of such potentials in physical hardware enables us to generate and sample from basic parameterized energy-based models. We demonstrate how to construct and train popular classes of machine learning models based on these hardware-native energy-based models, using the framework of probabilistic graphical models. We analyze the runtime and energy consumption of different models in this thermodynamic paradigm based on theoretical considerations and numerical studies. translated_title: 基于均衡的可微分连续变量热力学计算蓝图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.16183v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：为应对机器学习工作负载日益增长的能耗和延迟需求，我们提出了一种节能且快速的热力学计算栈蓝图，该栈利用物理硬件中的随机模拟过程。在本工作中，我们聚焦于基于能量的热力学计算，其中随机过程由具有可调能量势的朗之万动力学良好描述。在物理硬件中实现此类势能，使我们能够生成并从基本参数化基于能量的模型中采样。我们演示了如何基于这些硬件原生能量模型，使用概率图模型框架构建和训练流行的机器学习模型类别。我们基于理论考虑和数值研究，分析了该热力学范式下不同模型的运行时间和能耗。作为此类硬件的初步实验实现，我们提供了初步结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于均衡可微分连续变量热力学计算的蓝图，通过物理硬件中的朗之万动力学实现节能高效的机器学习模型训练，并分析了其能耗和性能优势。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a blueprint for equilibrium-based differentiable continuous-variable thermodynamic computing, leveraging Langevin dynamics in physical hardware for energy-efficient machine learning model training, with analysis of runtime and energy consumption.
